Report Transformation — Transactions

The Report Transformation Transactions report displays the underlying transactions that are used in report transformation calculations. This report helps you understand how transformed values are derived from your original transaction data.

Report transformations allow you to create modified versions of standard reports by applying specific rules or calculations to the original data. This transactions report shows exactly which source transactions contribute to each transformed value, providing full transparency into the calculation process.

Use this report when you need to verify the accuracy of transformed report values or trace back to the original transactions that were included in a transformation calculation.
